## W06 Authorized tool and data record

W06   Workflow ID __________   Version/date __________   Status __________

Prepared by __________   Accountable owner __________   Evidence location __________

Done when: tool, configuration, data and connections are recorded against verified evidence; the named approver has ticked a status; and an expiry or review date is set.

Source basis: [Slow AI Kitchen](https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen) · [GRC Workbook](https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook) · [AI GRC Copilot](https://github.com/rolldabones/AI-GRC-Copilot)

**Tool provider and configuration**

Tool, service/plan, model identifier if exposed, prompt/template version, technical owner and date checked.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Permitted workflow and users**

Task tier, operating tier, authorized operators, intended outputs and prohibited actions.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Data and connections**

Sources and classification; recipients; storage/retention; training use; access permissions; integrations and third parties. Link verified configuration and contract evidence.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Operating controls and limitations**

Access control, logging, review, budgets where relevant, vendor-change visibility and manual fallback.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Approval and review**

Approver, authority, approval date, permitted environment, expiry/review date and revalidation triggers.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Status   [ ] Proposed   [ ] Approved for rehearsal   [ ] Approved for specified use   [ ] Suspended

Training or reference applications are not automatically approved destinations for Client information. A platform description is not proof that a specific deployment enforces the required control.
